cohort: 70 children with and without food allergy (56 with food allergy and 14 healthy controls)
finding: Dysbiosis, particularly a higher abundance of certain bacteria, is associated with food allergy, especially in older children with peanut allergy, while younger children with and without food allergy show fewer differences in gut microbiota.
mod_finding: This study on gut microbiota and food allergy in children considered mode of delivery as a factor but did not find significant differences between groups based on it.
